title: Source affine dictionary
statement:
With the same schemes, qcqs f, flat g and pullback.snd, quasi-coherent F, injective resolutions I,J, degree p, affine V,W with W contained in g inverse V, and restricted resolution data D defined by [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices], [def-pc-module-pullback], [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison], [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap] and [pqf-def-cohomology], put A=Gamma(S,V), B=Gamma(S',W), U=f inverse V, h=the restriction followed by V's affine chart, N=F restricted to U, P=R^p f_* F, Q=R^p f'_* g'^* F. There exist an additive eH from module cohomology on U to HOver(h,N,p), and a bijective B-linear a from B tensor_A HOver(h,N,p) to Gamma(g^*P,W), with a(s tensor xi)=s times the restricted pullback unit of D.sourceClass(eH inverse xi). This asserts only the source comparison and contains no target comparison.

Exact Lean statement:
theorem Scheme.Modules.exists_flatBaseChange_affine_source
    {X S S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] [Flat g] [Flat (pullback.snd g f)]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (J : InjectiveResolution
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F))
    (p : ℕ) (V : S.Opens) (W : S'.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
    (eVW : W ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (D : Scheme.Modules.FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f g F I J V) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(S, V) Γ(S', W) := (g.appLE V W eVW).hom.toAlgebra
    let h := f.resLE V (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl ≫ V.toSpecΓ
    let N := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj F
    let P := ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).rightDerived p).obj F
    ∃ (eH : ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace p).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj F)) ≃+
          Scheme.Modules.HOver h N p)
      (a : TensorProduct Γ(S, V) Γ(S', W) (Scheme.Modules.HOver h N p) →ₗ[Γ(S', W)]
        Γ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj P, W)),
      Function.Bijective a ∧
      (∀ (s : Γ(S', W)) (xi : Scheme.Modules.HOver h N p),
        a (s ⊗ₜ[Γ(S, V)] xi) = s •
          ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj P).presheaf.map (homOfLE eVW).op
            (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
              ((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction g)).unit.app P)
              V (D.sourceClass p (eH.symm xi))))

proof.text: Compare module and abelian/Ext cohomology on a common section complex over U. Identify restriction with open-immersion pullback. Naturality for multiplication gives the A-linear canonical comparison eH.

Quasi-coherent higher images have no positive cohomology on affine V. The cocycle-normalized Leray edge and the presheaf description identify D.sourceClass with an A-linear equivalence into Gamma(P,V), independently of augmentation-preserving restricted resolution choices.
Apply the existing affine tensor-pullback sections construction to P, swap tensor factors, and extend the source equivalence by B. Its unit formula gives the required normalization.
